features.name: User Authentication
features.description: Login, logout, password reset, and session management for admin, manager, and user roles

features.name: User Management
features.description: Create, invite, delete users with role-based permissions. Supports admin, manager, and regular user roles

features.name: Report Upload and Management
features.description: Users can upload Excel reports, admins/managers can view, approve, or reject reports

features.name: Payment Management
features.description: Users upload payment proofs, admins/managers review and approve/reject payments

features.name: Attendance Management
features.description: Users submit attendance with geolocation and photo, managers/admins review submissions

features.name: Dashboard Analytics
features.description: Role-based dashboards showing statistics and recent activity for admins, managers, and users

features.name: Notifications
features.description: Real-time notifications for approvals, rejections, and system events

features.name: Settings Management
features.description: System settings for session timeout, geofencing, and integrations
